_source: Map.cs and GridCell.cs (RECONSTRUCTION 5): a 1900 x 1200 map of 16 px cells, and SpawnBridge(), the one authored level. Pixels, y down; the Runtime converts at units.pixelsPerUnit.

bridge._about: SpawnBridge(): every cell of the floor row and of each wall column is Hard, white and opaque, with the second tile of the tileset's top row. Walls run all rows; the floor runs all columns.

structures._about: Owner decision 2026-10-23 (U.VAN-T25): block structures between the bridge's two walls (columns 21-39 are open) for Leo, who cannot wall slide, to climb and jump across; every character can use them. Each block is a rectangle of Hard cells, from its top-left cell to its bottom-right cell inclusive, [column, row]; the floor is row 30 (its top at y 480). A stair of a 3-high and a 6-high block against the right wall, then two-cell ledges each 3 rows higher, zigzagging left and back right across one- to three-column gaps. Columns 28, 31 and 34 (the spawn and reset x 450, 500, 550) stay clear, so every character still falls straight to the floor; columns 21-26 stay clear, so the left wall is the original's for wall slides and wall jumps; and rows 27-29 are clear left of the stair, so a 3-cell character walks the floor unhindered.

units._about: The one place the original's pixels and frames meet the Runtime's units (BIBLE: one grid cell is one unit; the simulation steps at 60 Hz).

draw._about: SceneManager.Draw clears to CornflowerBlue, then Map.Draw draws the outline (Shape.CreateBox over the map rectangle, a 1 px white line of stretched 1x1 texture), then each layer if ShowLayers, then the cells (RECONSTRUCTION 5, 6). area_1 is the 1920 x 1200 painted mountain-farmhouse backdrop, drawn whole and unscaled at (0, 0) in white; the four parallax images beside it were never loaded and are not listed. Colours are [r, g, b, a].
